name: Mega Ring
description: Enables {PKMN} holding their Mega Stone to Mega Evolve.

gifts.note: Beat the Lavaridge Gym Leader (Badge 4). After the battle you get the Mega Ring, which lets you Mega Evolve, and TM Package 4 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case). If your Bag had no room, talk to the Leader again.
